R3.description: A malformed version such as v2.12.0 gets the not-a-version refusal with one next step, name a release as X.Y.Z

R4.description: Partial manager-block objects are specified in docs/release-metadata.md and every field is tested, failing closed; a repeated SHA256SUMS filename is refused and tested at both callers

R5.description: The traversal-version and unreadable-source doctor CLI tests exist

R6.description: An overlap of a concrete frozen key and a frozen:* orphan key is refused, with a test

R7.description: The nightly saves a cache entry only when its lock differs from the committed one

R8.description: Each of #39 to #52 has one recorded disposition; #44 and #45 are dropped with reasons and #50 is a follow-up for its own later milestone; the change is a fix: title and no pin, version or frozen semantic changes
